g.text: OMNI-MESH: TWO-TIERED DECENTRALIZED TRAFFIC & EDGE SECURITY PLATFORM
Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (PPO) with High-Priority Security Gating and Zero Single Point of Failure (ZSPF)
• Async Paho-MQTT Client with non-blocking threading loop
• MessagePack Serialization: ~82 Bytes per frame (JSON strictly forbidden)
Peer-to-Peer Inter-Intersection State Exchange (Halting Queues, Signal Phase)
Payload: Binary MsgPack (~80B) | Frequency: 1.0 Hz | QoS 0 (Low Latency)
Tier-2 Orchestrator Liveness Signal & Global Watchlist Synchronization
Timeout Trigger: > 3.0s forces instant failover from Mode 0 to Mode 1
High-Priority Security Directives: Target Signal Locking (Target: Node C2 / 2_2)
Temporal Gating: Injects Threat Flag m(t) = 1 (Temporally Overrides RL)
P2P Preemption for Emergency Responders (Ambulance AMB_01)
Rolling Corridor Clearing: Instant arterial Green along Corridor Row
• POST /api/trigger/kill_broker: Severs MQTT TCP transport completely.
• Verified Response: Instant transition to Mode 2 (Max-Pressure Island) with ≤25% loss floor.
Prevents false-positive lockdowns from optical noise or thermal blur:
Rule: ≥ 2 Adjacent Nodes must verify Plate within 30s Window
• Directives: Lock target approach RED; divert cross traffic to escape routes
Verified Empirical Benchmark: 100.0% Containment Rate (vs 0% MaxPressure)
Physical containment is safety-critical. Automated MAS recommendations
must be validated by law enforcement dispatcher before physical signal locking:
Authorization: Dual-key cryptographic signature or operator override
• Transmits 1 Hz keepalive frame on omnimesh/tier2/heartbeat
• Edge Nodes reset local timeout watchdog timers on receipt
ECLIPSE SUMO MICROSCOPIC PHYSICS ENGINE & TRACI HARNESS
Generates ground-truth vehicle dynamics, car-following physics (Krauss model), and multi-directional traffic demand.
Local server (http://localhost:5000) streaming real-time microscopic radar telemetry to web dashboard.
